project.name: Layer-Aware Post-Quantum Cryptography for Blockchain-Based Energy Trading
project.authority_rule: Later direct professor clarification overrides the student specification only for the clarified point; the proposal is background and lower authority.
project.measurement_principle: Measure and retain what the system actually does; do not tune results to an expected model.

canonical_e0_server_environment.provenance_note: Historical environment for the retained canonical E0 server run; current host versions must not overwrite it without an E0 rerun.

current_host_observation.provenance_note: Inventory only; these values are not retroactively attributed to retained measurements.

e0_benchmark.status: canonical server data retained; meter/SBC data missing

e1_benchmark.status: functional for all four identity configurations; fixed-profile candidate data retained for ECDSA/ML-DSA-44/ML-DSA-65; SPHINCS+ fixed-profile saturation/failure retained; final E1 CSV incomplete

hybrid_pq_identity.description: Experimental hybrid Fabric identity mechanism: ECDSA X.509 membership and CA chain, a noncritical extension carrying the PQ algorithm and public key, and real liboqs-based peer transaction/endorsement signing and verification.
hybrid_pq_identity.orderer_binary_note: Patched to verify requests signed by PQ peer identities

cpu_control.note: Required future-run state; each retained run log records the observed per-CPU values.

fabric_block_parameters.effective_value_source: Decoded generated/current Fabric common.Block config with configtxlator; configtx.yaml is the declarative source.

block_utilisation.definition: mean(actual ordinary-transaction block bytes) / effective PreferredMaxBytes
block_utilisation.scientific_condition: Use blocks closed by volume, not a BatchTimeout-driven half-empty regime.
block_utilisation.diagnostic_rate_status: 300 TPS was a block-filling probe only; Gateway concurrency-limit failures make it invalid for final latency or tps_sustained.
block_utilisation.observed_closure: Blocks 17-47 each contain MaxMessageCount=500 ordinary transactions, demonstrating steady-state count-limit closure rather than BatchTimeout closure. Block 48 is a terminal 386-transaction ordinary block.

full_500_transaction_block_diagnostic_co.status: diagnostic comparison only; not the current working result

installed_images_at_metadata_update.validation: Rebuilt after the pqPublicKey.Private() correction; Fabric PQ regression tests passed, both binaries report Fabric 2.5.16 commit f871cf9 built with Go 1.26.4 and link to liboqs/libcrypto, and local binary disassembly confirms pqPublicKey.Private() returns false.

data_provenance.candidate_timing_status: ECDSA/ML-DSA-44/ML-DSA-65 pass sample-count and zero-failure checks, but historical logs did not retain the full preflight now required.
data_provenance.sphincs_status: Current working report is fixed-profile saturation: warmup 700/301 success/fail, 50 TPS 891/5110, and 200 TPS 46/23955, with Gateway concurrency-limit errors. This is excluded from normal latency candidates; no lower-rate replacement is currently authorized.

identity_evidence.status: Per-peer ECDSA signcert sizes from the blockutil-300 network are retained without aggregation; other configurations require future matching network setup.

dataset.status: required for E7; not yet selected

known_scientific_decisions_pending.sphincs_fixed_profile: Current decision is to report identical-profile saturation and not run a lower-rate benchmark now; ask later whether supplemental lower-rate latency characterization is required.
known_scientific_decisions_pending.block_filling: Ask whether MaxMessageCount-driven closure at about 93.76% of PreferredMaxBytes satisfies the intended filled-by-volume methodology.
known_scientific_decisions_pending.terminal_residual_block: The current working ECDSA rho includes terminal ordinary block 48 (386 transactions), because only genesis/config exclusion was specified; ask whether terminal partial ordinary blocks should instead be excluded.
known_scientific_decisions_pending.identity_bytes_aggregation: Ask how four per-peer identity file sizes map to the single E1 CSV field (mean, median, max, or another rule).
known_scientific_decisions_pending.tps_sustained_criterion: Exact operational threshold for highest linear/sustainable rate.
known_scientific_decisions_pending.latency_field_population: The E1 schema has one endorsement/commit value per configuration while the fixed profile has 50 TPS and 200 TPS rounds; no authoritative rule yet selects one round or a combined population.
known_scientific_decisions_pending.sanity_gate_source: The student specification references a supplied make_figures.py checker, but its plausible bands/source file are absent.

notes.falcon_liboqs_caveat: Falcon in liboqs 0.15.0 follows the round-3 submission rather than final FIPS 206.
notes.ecdsa_api_note: E0 uses the low-level OpenSSL ECDSA API, deprecated in OpenSSL 3.0, to measure the primitive directly without provider dispatch.
